name: Elauwit Connection Inc.
summary: Elauwit Connection, Inc. delivers broadband internet networks to multifamily residences and student housing developments across the United States. The company manages the entire process of fiber optic and WiFi network deployment within each contracted property, including initial design, installation, ongoing operation, and maintenance. Their service portfolio extends to providing bandwidth, offering continuous 24/7 network monitoring, performing essential network upkeep, and delivering resident support. Elauwit caters to a variety of clients, such as wholesale partners, Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), property owners, and property management companies. Founded in 2019, its main corporate office is located in Cheyenne, Wyoming.
